route.title: Relay route
route.description: Variable-map relay signals to energise (close) before the read, e.g. ["mux_input_w1", "mux_pl_w1"]. All are opened again after. Empty = read with no relay change.

read_signal.title: Signal to read
read_signal.description: Variable-map signal measured once the route is settled (e.g. winding1_voltage, no_load_current, feedback_voltage).

min.title: Min limit
min.description: Lower acceptance limit for this model. From the product spec / recipe — not invented.

max.title: Max limit
max.description: Upper acceptance limit for this model. From the product spec / recipe — not invented.

settle_s.title: Settle time (s)
settle_s.description: Dwell after closing the route before reading (relay operate time + meter integration).

name.title: Measurement name
name.description: Name recorded for the measurement (defaults to the read signal).

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit recorded with the measurement (V, A, Hz).
